marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Disc 1: The Next Doctor. Christmas 1851, and Cybermen stalk Victorian London. The Tenth Doctor discovers a spate of mysterious deaths, and he's surprised to meet another Doctor! Are two doctors enough to stop the rise of the CyberKing?. Disc 2 : Planet of The Dead. When a London bus takes a detour to an alien world, the Doctor must join forces with the extraordinary Lady Christina. But the mysterious planet holds terrifying secrets hidden in the sand. Disc 3: The Waters of Mars. Mars, 2059. Dowie Base One. Last Recorded message. " Don't drink the water. Not one drop". 'The water of Mars' ws first broadcast 5 years ago today...
